summary: Reviewed 90d77613 feat(models): verify Parakeet archive checksum before install. Diff vs origin/master (6d98b41) adds sha2 0.10 to Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock and, in src/models.rs, a sha256 field on ModelSpec plus sha256_hex/verify_archive and four tests. Intended behavior: after downloading the archive and before extraction, hash it and compare to the pinned digest; on mismatch remove the archive and fail. Independently verified the pinned sha256 43d37191602727524a7d8c6da0eef11c4ba24320f5b4730f1a2497befc2efa77 by streaming the upstream 478517071-byte archive through sha256sum. checks fmt/clippy/test all exit 0 (102 lib, 6 bin, 4 http tests pass). origin/master is an ancestor of the revision, so it can fast-forward. No blocking findings.
